newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-LARA SURVIVES VISA SCARE TO RECEIVE AWARD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-LARA SURVIVES VISA SCARE TO RECEIVE AWARD.

text.p: Brian Lara survived a close call to get to a glittering function in time to receive the world's top cricketer award, officials said on Tuesday.

The West Indian was stranded at Bombay airport without a valid visa and organisers had to come to his rescue, organising a temporary one, although his passport was impounded for the duration of the stay.
Lara, who beat Australians Mark Waugh and Ian Healy to the award, received a trophy and a cheque for 500,000 rupees ($14,000).
The award was adjudicated by former test skippers Sunil Gavaskar of India, Clive Lloyd of the West Indies and Australia's Ian Chappell.
